generation: same v7 generator: numeric seed=instance_seed+1000003*N; fatigue heterogeneity+271828; no model/decoder changes
mixture: 50/50 only; iid independent fair branch per child, alternate strict alternation with seed-randomized first branch; separate branch/proposal random streams

coverage: all union-of-three-model TEC strict barrier states; swap_rebind endpoints verified subset of ordinary N2; mixture union equals N2; exact parent-fixed p16/p32 and alternate8+8/16+16, separate from changing-parent search

FE: one paid minimal parent+32 full child calls=33, including duplicate/noop/late calls; alternate exactly16+16 attempts in FE mode; no partial evaluations
timing: before RNG/parent decode through candidate generation, branch selection, full decode, in-memory records and acceptance; late child charged but cannot improve returned solution; overshoot retained
acceptance: strict TEC descent in initial-parent normalized units >1e-10; no uphill or neutral moves
ordering: fixed independent method-order randomization per parent/model/search_seed/budget; one process, BLAS threads1; all single methods rerun in current harness
primary: 8 new N4 instances, strong_fast TEC, union-barrier and uniform strata separate, 33FE/20ms/80ms all retained; beta0/slow controls; development not confirmation
statistics: average3 seeds within physical parent, paired per numeric instance; win/tie/loss and mean differences, no correlated-state p-values or posthoc ratio/seed/budget selection; combined strata descriptive only
interpretation: coverage retained relative to restricted swap is structural; no claim of new endpoints beyond plain, no guaranteed finite-budget dominance; classify dilution cost and actual use of both families separately
artifacts: fresh protocol/source/input/tables/graph/coverage/search/validation/failure/costs; old source/table provenance verified; final result independently fully decoded and schedule-checked
